checks.name: studio_http_rejection_recovers_without_socket_abort
checks.run:
import subprocess, sys
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-rA', 'tests/test_studio.py::test_http_surface_requires_session_token_and_enforces_body_limit'], capture_output=True, text=True)
summary = (result.stdout + result.stderr).lower()
assert result.returncode == 0 and '1 passed' in summary and 'skipped' not in summary and 'xfailed' not in summary
print('STUDIO_HTTP_FRAMING_PASS')
